FAQ

Common questions

How much should I spend on Google Ads? ▾
It depends on your market and goals. Most Illinois B2B businesses start at $1,500–3,000/month in ad spend. We’ll help you size the opportunity before you commit a dollar.
How quickly will I see results? ▾
Google Ads can generate leads within 24–48 hours of launch. But it takes 30–60 days of optimization to hit peak efficiency. We’re transparent about the ramp period.
What’s your management fee? ▾
Management fees are scoped based on your ad spend and campaign complexity. We discuss this on the strategy call — no hidden surprises.
Can you manage campaigns I’ve already started? ▾
Yes. We audit your existing campaigns, identify what’s working and what’s wasting budget, and take over management from there.
Do you work with small budgets? ▾
We can work with budgets as low as $1,000/month in ad spend, though the economics improve significantly at $2,500+. We’ll tell you honestly if Google Ads is the right channel for your budget.
